metadata.source: Court names: Ministry of Justice RTI list 'All Courts' (moj.gov.lk). Street addresses and phone numbers: public directory listings of Judicial Service Commission court data (lankainformation.lk directory pages for District, Magistrate's and High Courts). Districts/provinces assigned from geography.
metadata.note: Court list is as published by MOJ; spellings normalized. Verify addresses with the Judicial Service Commission (jsc.gov.lk) before relying on them.

address_precision_values.street: street/road-level address found in a public listing
address_precision_values.town-level: exact street not found; value gives the town, district and province where the court sits

metadata.phone_note: phone is null where no number was found. For general enquiries contact the JSC Secretariat: +94 11 2433119 / +94 11 2451159 (P.O. Box 573, Hulftsdorp, Colombo 12).
metadata.caveat: Directory listings are third-party and some are inconsistent (e.g. duplicated numbers across courts sharing a complex). Verify with the JSC before relying on them.
